spec.title: Does more parallelism buy anything on this endpoint?
spec.notes: Workers are something you control; the endpoint's queue depth is not. If wall clock does not fall as workers rise, the endpoint is serialising and the extra workers are buying rate-limit risk for nothing. Five repeats because latency on a shared endpoint is noisy, and three runs cannot tell a real effect from a busy minute.
